Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
duc...@LaBRI.U-Bordeaux.FR (Philippe DUCHON) writes:
>Last night we had a problem with a Pulled Fangs. PF states it can only be
>played by a vampire doing _more_ damage than the opposing vamp.

>The problem is, when is this decided ? When can one play Pulled Fangs ?

At the press step (after all strikes have resolved), or when the round
ends if it ends before the press step (one of the minions is no longer
ready or one of the strikes was a Combat Ends strike).

>Can it only be played after all strike resolutions have taken place ? After
>any strike resolution ? At any time in the round ? After a Drawing out the
>Beast has done its damage ?

Yes. No. No. No (DotB does it's damage after the press step, or when
then round ends prematurely - this latter case would still have DotB
deal its damage after the time at which you could play PF, I believe).

>The situation was Sarah Brando with the Sword of Judgement and 1 blood being
>blocked by Boy Toy with a Leather Jacket. Sarah striked for 2 damage, Boy
>Toy for one; Boy Toy prevented the damage with the Leather Jacket and tried
>to pull Sarah's fangs before she could hit him again. From that point on,
>there was much heated discussion among these two ancient patrons...

If Sarah gains additional strikes, Boy Toy will have to wait for all of
those strikes to resolve before Pulling Sarah's Fangs (at which point
he probably won't qualify for the job).
